notes.title: Patch Notes: Thu Jun 25, 2020
notes.content:
A new patch for Wintermoor just arrived!

Corrections to grammar/spelling errors in non-English languages.
Chinese font is bigger! Sorry that it was too small, we aren't familiar with Chinese. Thanks for the kindly-worded reports on the issue.
Minor tweaks and bugfixes.

notes.title: Wintermoor Tactics Club Language Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We're so excited to be releasing Wintermoor Tactics Club in German, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese! We thank all of you for your patience as we've been working around the clock to localize the game in these languages.

If you've enjoyed Wintermoor Tactics Club and wish to immerse yourself even further outside of the game, the official soundtrack is available! Alternatively, if you haven't picked up the game yet, the Wintermost Edition includes both the game and soundtrack!

Whether you've mastered C&C or if you've yet to jump into this cozy tactics RPG, we want to express our appreciation for all of the support we've received! Thank you all again!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Tue June 9, 2020
notes.content:
A new patch for Wintermoor just arrived!

Corrections to grammar/spelling errors (thanks for the reports, community)
Fixing a rare softlock bug in the first club battle
Tweaks to character spawn locations and movements in cutscenes
Hooking up a few conditionals that got lost, allowing for more reactive dialog in some campaign writing sections
Performance improvements to loading levels, and displaying the credits

notes.title: Patch Notes: Tue May 26, 2020
notes.content:
A new patch for Wintermoor just arrived!

Achievements previously earned but not awarded will be awarded next time you load the game and play a cutscene.
Fixed issue with capital "I" not rendering for some regions. Thanks to our users for reporting this.
Various small bugfixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Tue May 19, 2020
notes.content:
A new patch for Wintermoor just arrived!

Achievements are now correctly unlocking on Steam again. Thanks to the community for alerting us to this. This patch will NOT unlock achievements you earned and weren’t credited for over the past week, but we expect to have a patch within a week that WILL unlock them.
Even sexier saxophone version of "Tell Her How You Feel"
Fixed some odd mouse behavior when you changed focus on the game, and fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would render as a single white pixel in the center of the screen when you used a controller
Tweaked the difficulty on the second-to-last battle

notes.title: Patch Notes: Tue May 12, 2020
notes.content:
Wintermoor's very first patch is here!

Fixed a crash bug that would occur when you visited certain locations 40+ times
Saving / autosaving the game is much more performant and doesn’t leak memory
Added quicksave and quickload buttons (F5 and F9)
Fixed the softlock when losing a battle in chapter 1 under certain conditions
